terms.demo: One runnable Flow program or independently selectable shader entry.
terms.gallery: A visual collection of related demos with recorded or live output.
terms.showcase: The curated front door: a small cross-section chosen to explain what Flow can do.

collections.title: Photoreal FSL
collections.description: Ray-marched scenes and a procedural PBR-style material library: metals, glass, stone, coatings, soft materials, industrial surfaces and emissive studies.

collections.title: Games
collections.description: Complete playable games from arcade staples through puzzle, board and sandbox examples.

collections.title: Morphogenesis
collections.description: Reaction-diffusion, Turing patterns, aggregation, L-systems, Physarum, cellular automata and biological growth.

collections.title: Neurons & Networks
collections.description: Single neurons, cable models, plasticity, balanced networks, attractors and central pattern generators with quantitative gates.

collections.title: 3D
collections.description: A software rasterizer written in Flow: solids, voxels, terrain, particles, cameras, ray picking and rigid-body motion.

collections.title: Planet Pipeline
collections.description: A cubesphere world pipeline from tectonics through elevation, erosion, climate, biomes and a rotating final globe.

collections.title: Procedural Generation
collections.description: Noise atlases, heightmaps, domain warping, caves, Voronoi, islands, biomes and wave-function collapse.

collections.title: Evolutionary Biology
collections.description: Population genetics, evolutionary games, ecology, selection, drift, sweeps, Red Queen dynamics and spatial models.

collections.title: Opinion Dynamics
collections.description: Voter, Sznajd, majority-rule and bounded-confidence models with their conserved quantities or closed-form checks.

collections.title: Evolution Suite
collections.description: The language thesis directly: continuous, hybrid, population and control systems declared with Flow's evolution syntax.

collections.title: Numerical Methods
collections.description: Numerical algorithms that both visualize their state and gate correctness and performance, beginning with adaptive FMM.

collections.title: Live WebAssembly
collections.description: The same games and graphics programs compiled for the browser so the gallery becomes something you can play and manipulate.
